home.featuresTitle: Built to prepare you, not to make you recite

features.realisticText: Same duration, same number of questions, same formats and same navigation rules as the exam.
features.varietyText: Each mock exam is assembled from the bank, without repeating a question while the bank allows it.

features.progressText: A readiness index and the history of your scores, to know when you are ready.

faq.dumpsQ: Do the questions come from the real exam?
faq.dumpsA: No. Every question is original, written from Microsoft's public documentation and reviewed before publication. None comes from a real exam: memorising answers does not prepare you, understanding does.
faq.scoreQ: Is the score comparable to the exam's?
faq.scoreA: It uses the same scale, out of {maxScore} with {passScore} to pass, and the same domain weights. It is an indicator of readiness, not a guaranteed prediction of the result.
faq.resumeQ: What if I close the page during an exam?
faq.resumeA: Your answers are saved as you go. You pick up where you left off; the timer keeps running, as on exam day.
faq.freeA: {exams}, your score per domain, the correction of the questions you missed and progress tracking. Full access adds unlimited exams and the explanation of every option.

home.finalTitle: Ready to measure yourself against the exam?
home.finalText: A full mock exam, a score, and the precise list of what you still need to study.
